name: A Call for Help
Text: Action: Exhaust a character you control with an $ icon to search your deck for an _ character and put into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: A Single Path
Text: Play during the story phase before any characters are committed to stories. Action: Each player can only commit characters to a single story this phase.

name: Academic Obfuscation
Text: Attach to a story card. Opponents need 2 additional success tokens to win attached story.

name: Across Dimensions
Text: Play only if every character you control has the < faction. Action: Until the end of the phase, each < character gains X # icons, where X is the number of < characters in play.

name: Agency Groundskeeper
Text: Action: Exhaust Agency Groundskeeper to choose and exhaust a support card. If that card is a LOCATION, destroy it.

name: Antediluvian Dreams
Text: Play during your story phase, before characters are committed to stories. Action: Resolve an additional # struggle at all stories this phase.

name: Arcane Grifter
Text: Characters without an $ icon committed to the same story as Arcane Grifter do not count their skill.

name: Arkham Advertiser Archives
Text: Response: After you win a % struggle, exhaust Arkham Advertiser Archives to refresh 1 of your domains with 2 or fewer resources attached.

name: Ask Questions Later
Text: If you win this conspiracy, you may wound all characters in play.

name: Beneath the Surface
Subtitle: Eureka!
Text: Play during your story phase, before characters are committed. Action: Choose a story. Until the end of the phase, if you win an % struggle by at least 3 icons at that story, win that story immediately.

name: Binding Worm
Text: Characters cannot commit to stories alone.

name: Bite Marks
Text: Attach to a character. Response: After attached character is wounded, destroy that character.

name: Blackball Jim
Subtitle: Pool Hustler
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story to which Blackball Jim is committed, drain one of your domains to drain an opponent's domain. If your domain has more resources attached than your opponent's, place an additional success token on that story.

name: Bloodthirsty Zealot
Text: While there is at least one insane character in play, Bloodthirsty Zealot gains # #.

name: Book of Eibon
Subtitle: Mind Bending Revelations
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character's controller cannot have more than 5 cards in his hand. If that player has more than 5 cards in hand, that player must choose and discard cards from his hand until 5 cards remain.

name: Brain Transplant
Text: Action: Choose an insane character and a ready character controlled by the same player. The ready character goes insane, if able. Then, restore and ready the targeted insane character.

name: Brazen Hoodlum
Text: Characters without a # icon committed to the same story as Brazen Hoodlum do not count their skill.

name: Called by Azathoth
Text: Attach to a character. Treat attached character as if its printed text box were blank.

name: Campaign Chief
Text: Raise the cost to play all cards with printed cost 2 or lower by 1.

name: Changing the Names
Text: Action: Exchange all success tokens controlled by any player at 2 different stories.

name: Chess Prodigy
Text: When Chess Prodigy commits to a story on your turn, name a struggle type. Resolve that struggle type at that story by counting % icons instead of that struggle type's normal icons at that story this phase. The normal struggle effects still apply.

name: Clever Zoog
Text: Other characters you control at the same story as Clever Zoog gain $.

name: Coffee House
Text: Response: After you win an $ struggle by at least 2 icons, sacrifice Coffee House to ready all characters you control.

name: Communal Shower
Text: Players cannot commit characters they control from different factions to the same story.

name: Confident Rookie
Text: While Confident Rookie has a Weapon card attached, it gains # and Willpower. While Confident Rookie has a Vehicle card attached, it gains $ and Fast.

name: Conspiracy Theorist
Text: Players cannot win the game by winning story cards unless at least one of their won story cards is also a conspiracy card, or unless there are no story cards left in the story deck.

name: Descendant of Eibon
Subtitle: Master of the Black Arts
Text: Action: Discard 2 of your success tokens from a story to put Descendant of Eibon into play from your hand or into your hand from your discard pile. At the end of the phase, if Descendant of Eibon is still in play, return him to your hand.

name: Dimensional Worm
Text: Response: After Dimensional Worm commits to a story as the attacker, choose a struggle at that story. Resolve that struggle by counting $ icons instead of its regular icons. The effect of the struggle does not change.

name: Domestic Sacrifice
Text: Action: Discard the top 2 cards of any deck. You may choose and ready a < character for each < card discarded in this way.

name: Dr. Carson
Subtitle: Fringe Psychologist
Text: Action: Exhaust Dr. Carson to restore and ready an insane character.

name: Dynamite
Text: Attach to an _ character. Action: Discard Dynamite from play to wound all characters committed to the same story as attached character.

name: Eat the Dead
Text: Attach to a character you control. Disrupt:When attached character would be destroyed, attach it and Eat the Dead to any domain you control as resources.

name: Emerging Deep One
Text: Forced Response: After you play Emerging Deep One from your hand, choose and destroy a [ character.

name: Endless Interrogation
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story, discard a card at random from each opponent’s hand. Then, you may pay 1 to return Endless Interrogation to the top of your deck instead of discarding it.

name: Erich Zann
Subtitle: Strange Virtuoso
Text: If you win a @ struggle in which Erich Zann is participating, instead of the normal struggle effects, you choose which of your opponent's participating character goes insane.

name: Expendable Muscle
Text: If Expendable Muscle would be wounded or go insane, instead attach it to a character you control. Then, Expendable Muscle becomes an ATTACHMENT support card with the text: "Attached character gains TOUGHNESS +1 and WILLPOWER."

name: Eye of the Deep
Text: Action: Choose every character in play with printed skill 3 or lower. Those characters are considered 1 skill characters with no keywords or abilities and ##$ until the end of the phase.

name: False Papers
Text: Attach to a character. Action: Exhaust False Papers to give attached character a SUBTYPE of your choice until the end of the phase.

name: Field Researcher
Text: Response: After an opponent wins a story but chooses not to trigger its effect, exhaust Field Researcher to trigger that story, effect as if you had won the story. (It still goes to the winning opponent's won story pile.)

name: Foiled!
Text: Attach to a story card. Treat attached story as it its text box were blank.

name: Fountain of Youth
Text: If you win this conspiracy, you may restore and ready all characters in play.

name: Friend of the Family
Text: When Friend of the Family is committed to a story, each character controlled by an opponent committed to the same story gets -1 skill.

name: Fugitive Scientist
Text: Characters without an % icon committed to the same story as Fugitive Scientist do not count their skill.

name: Ghoulish Thrill Seeker
Text: Response: After a character is wounded, ready Ghoulish Thrill Seeker.

name: Gibbering Soul
Text: Response: After Gibbering Soul is destroyed, search your deck for a > character with a # icon, reveal it, and place it in your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Government Exorcist
Text: Response: After Government Exorcist commits to a story on your turn, choose an opponent's character with a @ icon. That character cannot commit to the same story as Government Exorcist.

name: Grim Wraith
Text: Response: After Grim Wraith commits to a story, choose an icon struggle at that story. Instead of resolving that struggle, resolve an additional @ struggle in its place.

name: Hand Restraints
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character loses # %.

name: Hapless Graduate Student
Text: If you would draw a card, you may choose not to draw a card. Forced Response: After you draw a card, Hapless Graduate Student goes insane.

name: Hideous Guardian
Text: Disrupt: Before another character you control is wounded, place the wound token(s) on Hideous Guardian instead of on the wounded character.

name: Howard Ludvinski
Subtitle: Visiting Artist
Text: Action: Trigger a non-conspiracy story card in your won story pile. Shuffle it back into the story deck before its effect resolves.

name: Idol of the Abomination
Text: Action:  Pay 2 to turn Idol of the Abomination into a character with @ @ # # and 3 skill until the end of the phase.

name: Infernal Obsession
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. While attached, you gain control of attached character. (If control changes again, discard Infernal Obsession from play.)

name: Insect Swarm
Text: The cost for all players to lay neutral cards is increased by 1.

name: Interrogation Center
Text: Neutral characters cannot commit to stories.

name: Julia Brown
Subtitle: Insomniac
Text: Julia Brown gains +1 skill for each insane character in play. Disrupt: If Julia Brown would go insane as the result of a @ struggle, sacrifice her instead. Then search your deck for a card titled "Julia Brown" or "The Sleepwalker", put it into play committed to the same story, and then shuffle your deck.

name: Julia Brown
Subtitle: Oddly Amphibious
Text: Forced Response: After Julia Brown commites to a story, discard 2 cards at random from your hand, then draw 2 cards.

name: Literature Professor
Text: “While every card you control has the { faction, Literature Professor gains: "Disrupt: After you win a story card, you may search the story deck to choose the next story card (from the story deck) to come into the game. (Shuffle the story deck when you are done.)"

name: Local Brew
Text: Attach to a character you control. Attached character gains FAST, and all of your characters committed to the same story as attached character gain FAST.

name: Long-Dead Prince
Subtitle: Ancient Royalty
Text: Action: If Long-Dead Prince is wounded, return him to his owner's hand.

name: Marshall Greene
Subtitle: Too Old For This...
Text: While Marshall Greene does not have any wounds, all of your characters committed to the same story as Marshall Greene gain WILLPOWER.

name: Midnight Alley
Subtitle: No Shelter from the Storm
Text: Response: After you lose an $ struggle, sacrifice Midnight Alley to choose an opponent. That player must choose one of his domains, then exchange the cards in his hand with the resource attached to that domain.

name: Military Bike
Text: Attach to a character you control. Disrupt: After a story to which attached character is committed resolves, exhaust Military Bike to commit attached character to any other story where characters are committed.

name: Mind Eater
Text: Action: Pay 1 to choose a character with an % icon. Until the end of the phase, that character loses an % icon and Mind Eater gains an % icon.

name: Muddy Waters
Text: Response: After a character enters a discard pile, exhaust Muddy Waters to exhaust a character.

name: Nebulous Ooze
Text: Action: Pay 1 to remove Nebulous Ooze from a story to which it is committed and commit a ready < character you control to that story, without exhausting that character.

name: Nocturnal Scavanger
Text: Response: After you win a # struggle, pay X to choose and destroy an ATTACHMENT card with printed cost X or lower.

name: Obsessive Inmate
Text: Obsessive Inmate does not un-commit from a story until that story is won.

name: Old Sea Dog
Text: Action: Exhaust Old Sea Dog to choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character loses all faction affiliations and becomes neutral.

name: Open Grave
Text: Response: After a character you control is destroyed, sacrifice Open Grave to put into play from your discard pile a > character with skill 3 or lower.

name: Pagan Hall
Subtitle: Science Department
Text: Disrupt: If you would place a success token at a story, exhaust Pagan Hall to instead place that success token on Pagan Hall. Action: Exhaust Pagan Hall to move any number of success tokens from it to a story of your choice.

name: Parallel Universe
Text: Action: Pay 1 to attach Parallel Universe from your hand to a story card. When resolving struggles at attached story, count the total skill of all participating characters instead of the icos to determine the winner of each struggle.

name: Path of Blood
Text: Action: Choose a neutral character in play. Return that character to its owner's hand.

name: Rabbit's Foot
Text: Attach to a { character. Response: After attached character commits to a story, reveal the top card of your deck, then put that card into your hand. If the revealed card was a character card, # struggles do not resolve at that story this phase.

name: Repo Man
Text: If you win a # struggle at a story to which Repo Man is committed, instead of the normal struggle effects, take control of a support card controlled by the losing player.

name: Samantha Grace
Subtitle: Incompetent Secretary
Text: Each player needs an additional story card in order to win the game.

name: Scalethorn Asylum
Subtitle: Amphibious Fort
Text: Action: Exhaust Scalethorn Asylum and pay 1 to choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains the Deep One subtype and # # $.

name: Scholarly Plagiarist
Text: If you win an % struggle in which Scholarly Plagiarist is participating, instead of the normal struggle effects, move a success token from the opponent's side of the story to yours.

name: Secret Stiletto
Text: Attach to a character you control. Disrupt: After you win a # struggle by at least 3 icons at a story to which attached character is committed, pay 2 to choose and wound a character controlled by the losing opponent.

name: Shadow Company
Subtitle: Ghastly Regiment
Text: X is the number of ] characters you control. Response: After you succeed at a story to which Shadow Company is committed alone, choose an opponent's character with lower skill than Shadow Company and return it to its owner's hand.

name: Shadow Sorceress
Text: Response: After you win an $ struggle in which Shadow Sorceress participated, return the topmost SPELL card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Shortsighted Librarian
Text: Response: After you win an $ struggle, look at the top card of any player's deck. You may put this card on the top of the deck, on the bottom of the deck, or it its owner's discard pile.

name: Silver Twilight Temptress
Text: Response: After Silver Twilight Temptress is committed to a story on your turn, choose a character without an % icon. That character must commit to the same story as Silver Twilight Temptress, if able.

name: Sleeping Pills
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. While attached character is committed to a story, @ struggles do not resolve at that story.

name: Sleepless Nights
Text: Play during your story phase, before characters are committed to stories. Action: Resolve an additional @ struggle at all stories this phase.

name: Spawn of the Sleeper
Text: Action: Choose a character that has gone insane as the result of a @ struggle this phase. Take control of that character.

name: Stealing the Glory
Text: Action: Choose a story. Until the end of the phase, you may place 1 success token on that story for each $ struggle you win at thay story.

name: Stealthy Byakhee
Text: Response: After Stealthy Byakhee commits to a story, choose an opponent's character with an $ icon. That character cannot commit to the same story as Stealthy Byakhee.

name: Strange Delusions
Text: Attach to a character or support card. Action: Exhaust Strange Delusions to give attached card a faction affiliation of your choice until the end of the phase.

name: Struggling Artist
Text: $ struggles are resolved first at any story to which Struggling Artist is committed. Disrupt: After you win an $ struggle in which Struggling Artist participated, choose a struggle at that story. Skip that struggle at this story this turn.

name: Summer Classes
Text: Action: Choose a character that is currently committed to a story. That character remains committed when that story resolves this phase, unless the story is won. That character cannot un-commit until that story resolves again.

name: Summoning Circle
Text: Action: Exhaust Summoning Circle and any number of > characters with X total $ icons to search your deck for a > character with cost X or lower, reveal it, and put it into your hand. (X is the number of $ icons on the characters exhausted for the cost.)

name: Tear Gas
Text: Action: Attach Tear Gast to a character. Tear Gas gains the ATTACHMENT subtype and the text: "Attached character gets -1 skill, and is destroyed if its skill is 0."

name: Terrifying Visage
Text: Attach to a character with a @ icon. Response: After you win a @ struggle, ready attached character.

name: The Black Goat's Rage
Text: Play only if every card you control has the > faction. Action: Each player counts the @ icons on all readied characters he controls. The player who counts the fewest @ icons must immediately choose two characters he controls to go insane, if able.

name: The Cornered Man
Subtitle: "Like an Animal"
Text: Disrupt: After you win a # struggle in which The Cornered Man participated, wound The Cornered Man to immediately resolve another # struggle at that story.

name: The Endless Investigation
Text: If you win this conspiracy, you may search your deck for any conspiracy card and put it into play, if able. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: The Path to Y'ha-nthlei
Text: If you win this conspiracy, you may trigger the effect of any story card currently in play.

name: The Sleepwalker
Subtitle: Trapped by Nightmare
Text: Response: After The Sleepwalker commits to a story, choose an opponent's character with a # icon. That character cannot commit to the same story as The Sleepwalker.

name: The Spawn of Madness
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story in which you were opposed, refresh all domains in play.

name: The Terror of the Tides
Text: Action: Pay 3 to put The Terror of the Tides into play from your hand. Then, give The Terror of the Tides 4 wounds.

name: The Thing Behind You
Subtitle: Turn around!
Text: Action: Pay 2 and return a ] character to your hand to put The Thing Behind You into play from your hand.

name: The Thing from the Shore
Text: Response: When you succeed at a story in which The Thing from the Shore participated, remove all wound tokens from The Thing from the Shore.

name: The Underwater Conspiracy
Text: If you win this conspiracy, you may cause all characters in play to lose WILLPOWER and then go insane, if able.

name: Those Without Faces
Text: Disrupt: After you win a @ struggle, the loser of the struggle discards a card from the top of his deck.

name: Tithe Collector
Text: Forced Response: After a player plays a card, raise the cost for that player to play cards by 1 until the end of the phase.

name: Total Eclipse
Text: Play during your story phase, before characters are committed to stories. Action: Resolve an additional $ struggle at all stories this phase.

name: Touched with Madness
Text: Play during your story phase. Action: For each @ struggle that you win this phase, instead of the normal struggle effect, you choose which of your opponent's participating characters goes insane.

name: Trent Dixon
Subtitle: Workaholic
Text: If Trent Dixon is able to commit to a story, he must commit to a story. If Trent Dixon is the only character you control that is committed to a story, count his skill and icons to all other story cards as well.

name: Under the Porch
Text: Action: Sacrifice Under the Porch to search your deck for a > character, and put it into play under your control. At the end of the phase, return that character to its owner's hand.

name: Underground Asylum
Text: Disrupt: Exhaust Underground Asylum and pay 1 to cancel an effect that would cause a character to go insane.

name: Unfathomable Elder Thing
Text: Response: After Unfathomable Elder Thing commits to a story, choose an opponent's character with an % icon. That character cannot commit to the same story as Unfathomable Elder Thing.

name: Unorthodox Psychologist
Text: Action: Exhaust Unorthodox Psychologist to look at an opponent's hand.

name: Unorthodox Tactics
Text: Resolve the skill comparison at this conspiracy before any of its struggles occur. If you win this conspiracy before any struggles occur, you may choose which of its struggles resolve.

name: Unspeakable Transformation
Text: Action: Choose a character you control with cost 3 or lower. Until the end of the phase, that character gains the icons of any other character you control.

name: Vaporous Isle
Text: While Vaporous Isle is ready, any character that would go insane is instead returned to its owner's hand. Forced Reponse: If an opponent succeeds at a story, exhaust Vaporous Isle.

name: Vengeful Hit
Text: Disrupt: After you lose an % struggle, choose a character with an % icon, remove that character from the story it is committed to, then exhaust it if it is not already exhausted.

name: Vengeful Mob
Text: Response: After you lose a # struggle, choose an opponent's character. If that character has fewer # icons than all of your characters that are not committed to a story, wound the target character.

name: Wandering Inmate
Text: Response: After an insane character is restored, exhaust Wandering Inmate to return that character to its owner's hand unless its owner pays the printed cost of that character.

name: With a Fine Toothed Comb
Text: Play during your story phase, before characters are committed to stories. Action: Resolve an additional % struggle at all stories this phase.
